Unit P30 (new plan); Generate allowed on dev. The first attempt (18:55 JST) never ran: the agent stopped on an API error with 0 tokens during the session-limit outage (verdict Blocked, 'checkpoint was never saved'; its 2 seeded rows were deleted) — kept as P30.first-run-api-error.verdict.json. Re-run 19:12 JST: Pass on all 4 checkpoints. Hospital (H-03 cellulitis text) and Nursing Home (N-04 CHF-rehab text): Vitals, Labs and Diagnostic Testing show their empty states; stored vitals {}, labs [], radiology []; no 'afebrile', 'vital signs stable', 'hemodynamically stable' or 'No past medical history' on the tab or in the note; both notes write 'Vital signs: not dictated today' (UAT 3.4 / 3.7); cephalexin, named only as a plan, got no tracker row (the cefazolin row carries it in its change note).
